incidents.name: Axioma presale price business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: The Axioma presale contract sells AXT at a fixed rate that ignores the market price, so a flash loan could buy AXT cheaply in the presale and immediately dump it into the PancakeSwap pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: presale 0x2C25aEe99ED08A61e7407A5674BC2d1A72B5D8E3 created 2023-02-01T17:54:51Z by 0x624d2fa2a92c657725b3770e2dc6693be1562071, unrelated to attack sender 0xaaa75b2ae8314ef738062da56e0f09d2d53c43d2; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 53.3053 WBNB left the AXT/WBNB pair and the attacker netted 20.8053 WBNB after repaying the flash loan; 20.8053 WBNB x $332.09 at incidentTimestamp 1682316209 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $6,909.
